title: NASA Sun fact sheet: surface emission 62.94
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists surface emission as 62.94.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Surface emission (10 6 J/m 2 s) as 62.94 for the Sun. Listed under bulk parameters, not under the model-center heading. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
